name: Dead-wood Borer Moth
desc: Dead-wood Borer Moth (Scolecocampa liburna): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Scolecocampa liburna, the dead-wood borer, is a moth in the family Erebidae. The species was first described by Carl Geyer in 1837.
